newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Minsheng bank sees $1.32 mln profit in '96.
newsitem.headline: China's Minsheng bank sees $1.32 mln profit in '96.

text.p: The China Minsheng Banking Corp, China's first non-state bank, saw profits of 11.0 million yuan ($1.32 million) in 1996, its first year of operation, the Financial News said on Sunday.
Assets of the bank had reached 8.0 billion yuan at the end of last year while deposits were 4.3 billion yuan, the newspaper said.
The bank extended a total of 2.6 billion yuan in loans last year, it said but gave no further details.
The Minsheng bank was set up in January, 1996 and had a registered capital of 1.38 billion yuan last December, about 85 percent of which came from private businesses.

Bank officials had said they did not expect the bank to generate a profit in its first year of operation due to start-up costs. The newspaper did not say whether the figures for 1996 were pre-tax, but Chinese companies usually give pre-tax figures.
Officials have said they are aiming for a 50 perecnt return on shareholder capital by the third year of operation.
